description: Defines the TailLogCommand struct which implements a command-line interface command to tail recent transcripts from the TranscriptsStore.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that retrieves and prints the latest 10 transcript lines from TranscriptsStore.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the latest transcripts and prints the last 10 entries.
